about.bio: Building production frontends since 2018 — from a <hugeCorporation>large e-commerce SaaS</hugeCorporation> and an <agency>agency</agency> to product startups. Frontend Lead experience on a US-based SaaS. Focus: design systems, performance, and accessibility.
about.looking: Open to Senior or Lead Frontend roles — remote, worldwide. Best fit: SaaS, fintech, or any product that takes performance, accessibility, and design systems seriously. English / Russian.

helium10.position: Frontend Developer · US SaaS for Amazon sellers
description: Built Adtomic — Amazon advertising automation: keyword campaigns, price and competitor monitoring.
Contributed to the internal UI library — components, Storybook documentation, and tests.
Engineered dashboards and tooling that let Amazon sellers manage campaigns at scale.
Joined pre-MVP and shipped to production. Built shared design-system and helper packages reused across multiple projects.
Built a content-block builder in the admin panel — sliders, carousels, event grids — letting marketing assemble pages without engineering involvement.
Tuned page caching and server/client workload split, improving Next.js load times.
Implemented WCAG accessibility — high-contrast themes, font-size and letter-spacing controls. Mentored junior developers and reviewed code.

zoftify.position: Senior Frontend Engineer · Product studio (US clients)
description: Tourseta — multi-tenant SaaS for tour operators. Built booking flow and per-operator admin on a Next.js monorepo (Radix UI, Tailwind, TanStack Query).
Integrated Stripe + Airwallex payments, NextAuth authentication with role-based access, FeatureHub flags, and next-intl i18n across Tourseta booking and admin surfaces.
Optimized Tourseta performance and bundle size — measurable load-time and UX gains on slow networks.
Readyhubb — service marketplace. Built admin panels and dashboards with Next.js, Stripe, Chart.js, and Tailwind. Designed flexible interfaces for non-technical content management.

schoolbusmanager.position: Senior Frontend Engineer · Bus-operations SaaS for US school districts
description: Led a major frontend refactor — owned architecture decisions, code-review process, and shared patterns across the team.
Optimized critical-path screens — up to 7× faster in production through targeted refactors and bundle work.
Migrated Webpack → Vite (dev rebuild from ~12s to <1s) and Redux → RTK Query under FSD architecture.
Introduced TypeScript across the codebase — safer refactors, earlier error detection.
Rolled out Zustand for local state and centralized modal management; set up linting, formatting, and CI automation.

layers.position: Senior Frontend Engineer · Early-stage work-management platform
description: Contributing across packages — Projects (tasks, sprints, kanban), Pages (rich pages with databases), Flow (visual automations), and Meet (in-app video on LiveKit).
Shipped feature work: sprint move across projects/folders, task attachments, project-creation wizard, modal flows, kanban interactions.
UX polish across the app — assignee dropdowns, color pickers, badges, share panel; mobile adaptivity for the task detail view.
i18n coverage in settings and shared components (Mantine 8, i18next). Stack: React 18 + Vite + Zustand + Redux Toolkit + TanStack Query in a monorepo.

interestingExperience.intro: A few frontend problems from recent work — performance, architecture, and tooling — where the solution wasn't obvious upfront.
items: Migrated a long-lived admin panel from CRA + Webpack to Vite, replacing Redux with RTK Query along the way. Dev rebuild dropped from ~12s to under 1s; production bundle shrank by roughly a third.

Inherited dashboards with 60+ row tables that scrolled at single-digit fps. Profiled hot paths, virtualized the lists, memoized the heavy renders, and unified server-state caching — got it to a steady 60 fps on 1000+ rows.

Built a content-block builder for a marketing CMS where admins compose pages from typed blocks (slider, product carousel, event grid). Replaced ad-hoc landing pages and removed the need for engineering involvement in promo launches.
interestingExperience.outro: Each one came down to careful profiling, the right abstraction, and shipping something measurably better.

items.schoolbusmanager: Bus operations SaaS for US school districts — three apps: admin panel (main product), parent app, and the marketing landing I built from scratch. Led a major frontend refactor — migrated Webpack → Vite, Redux → RTK Query, adopted FSD. Up to 7× perf gains on critical screens.
items.tourseta: Multi-tenant SaaS for tour operators — booking flow + admin. Frontend on a Next.js monorepo with Radix UI, TanStack Query, Stripe/Airwallex payments, NextAuth, FeatureHub.
items.layers: Work-management platform — pages with databases, projects (tasks/sprints), forms, visual automations (Flow), in-app video on LiveKit (Meet), and CRM in one workspace. Web + desktop (JAR) builds. React 18 + Vite + Mantine + TanStack Query.
items.prosv: Animated photographer portfolio at Aeroidea. Next.js + TanStack Query, image-driven layout with motion-based section transitions.
items.cocktails: Take-home: cocktail browser pulling a public API, cocktail ID read from the URL. React, TypeScript, RTK Query, Vite.
items.relines: Take-home for Relines: user table from a public API with rate-up/rate-down and ban/promote actions. Tailwind + Framer Motion.
items.capture: Pet project — exploring page transitions and motion choreography with Framer Motion and styled-components.
items.music: 10-track music player — minimalist UI / UX exercise with playback controls.
items.todolist: Classic todo — add by Enter (deduped), filter active / completed, bulk-clear completed.
